notSetUp.title: Proof of Build is not set up on this deployment
notSetUp.body: This copy of SimLab has no Solana program or issuer key, so it cannot write credentials. Everything else in the lab works.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.useDevnetHint: One click. A test key kept in this browser, for Solana devnet only. Never put real funds in it.
wallet.pickerDescription: Phantom, Solflare and Backpack appear here when they are installed. Set them to devnet first.
wallet.noBrowserWallets: No browser wallet found on this device. The SimLab devnet wallet works everywhere.
wallet.faucetDone: 0.02 devnet SOL is in your wallet.
wallet.exportWarning: Anyone with this key controls the wallet. It is for devnet only: never send real SOL to it.
wallet.exportHow: To use the same wallet in Phantom, Solflare or Backpack, choose Import private key and paste it.
wallet.forgetBody: The key is deleted from this browser. Its credentials stay on-chain, but you can't use the wallet again unless you exported the key.

errors.walletFailed: The wallet couldn't connect. Check that it is unlocked and set to devnet.
errors.noFunds: Not enough devnet SOL. Get some from the faucet first.
errors.faucetUsed: The faucet gives each wallet and each network one drip per hour.
errors.enoughFunds: This wallet already has enough devnet SOL.
errors.faucetDry: The SimLab faucet is empty right now. The public faucet at faucet.solana.com also works.
errors.notPassed: The server re-ran your run and it did not pass. Start over and do each check in order.
errors.notVerifiable: The server can't re-run this kind of check yet.
errors.runMismatch: The run log didn't match this lab item.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.upstream: Solana devnet didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the SimLab server. Check your connection.
errors.notConfigured: This deployment can't write to Solana.

panel.title: Proof of Build
panel.lede: Pass the checks here and the server re-runs your run before it writes a credential to Solana devnet. You pay nothing.
panel.waitingFigure: Waiting for the figure. Recording starts when it reports the bench.
panel.recording: Recording this run from the figure.

steps.smokeHint: Catch a short before the battery does.
steps.motorsHint: Never spin motors on the bench with props on.

panel.violations: A safety rule was broken in this run: {rules}. Start over to try again.

rules.props-early: props went on before the checks
rules.inconsistent: the run log doesn't add up

panel.fault: The battery cap is vented. Unplug, re-seat the XT60 the right way round and re-run the smoke test.
panel.otherLab: Lesson and bench credentials arrive when the server can re-run those checks. Today you can earn the bench safety credential on any drone.
panel.needsPass: Pass every check above to mint.

phases.check: Checking the run on this device
phases.server: The server re-runs it and mints
phases.chain: Reading it back from the chain

panel.successBody: {skill} is on Solana devnet with your replay hash. Anyone can verify it.
panel.already: This wallet already holds this credential.

bounties.none: No open bounties for this skill yet.
bounties.readError: Couldn't read the bounties from Solana devnet.
bounties.formLede: Lock devnet SOL for a skill. It pays out to the next learner whose verified run earns that credential, in the same transaction.
bounties.learnerHint: A wallet address. Leave it empty to pay whoever earns the credential first.
bounties.learnerInvalid: That is not a Solana wallet address.
bounties.amountInvalid: Enter an amount between 0.001 and 1 SOL.
bounties.created: Bounty locked. It pays out on the next verified pass.
bounties.mineEmpty: You don't sponsor any bounties yet.
bounties.cancelled: Bounty cancelled. The SOL is back in your wallet.
bounties.needsWallet: Connect a wallet to sponsor a bounty.

tip.title: Tip {name}
tip.description: Send a little devnet SOL with the memo {memo}. Everyone in the room sees it.

credential.soulbound: Non-transferable: it lives at a program address tied to this wallet and skill.

passport.metaDescription: Your SimLab devnet wallet, the Proof of Build credentials you earned on Solana and the bounties you sponsor.
passport.title: Your passport
passport.lede: Credentials you earned in the lab, written to Solana devnet after the server re-ran your run. Sponsors can lock bounties that pay out on the next verified pass.
passport.credentialsEmpty: No credentials yet. Pass the bench safety checks on any drone to earn your first.
passport.connectFirst: Connect a wallet to see your credentials.

verify.metaDescription: Check any SimLab Proof of Build credential straight from Solana devnet, without trusting SimLab.
verify.title: Verify a credential
verify.lede: Paste a wallet or credential address. The data comes straight from Solana devnet, so you don't have to trust SimLab.
verify.invalid: That is not a Solana address.
verify.empty: Enter an address, or open a link someone shared with ?learner= or ?credential=.
verify.noneForLearner: No SimLab credentials for this wallet.
verify.noCredential: This address is not a SimLab credential.
verify.how: The lab records your inputs. The server replays them through the same pure check functions the page used, and only then signs issue_credential. The sha256 of those inputs is stored on-chain as the replay hash.
